items.title: Automated Deployment for Facilitator in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces automatic deployment for FacilitatorX402 when changes are pushed to the main branch, while retaining manual dispatch options. It ensures production deployments are serialized to prevent overlap and maintains the existing deployment sequence for safety. Additionally, a new workflow contract test has been added to validate triggers and concurrency settings.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with Resolution Controls in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new resolution pricing controls for MiniMax, allowing users to select between 768P and 2K options. Additionally, it mandates prompts in all MiniMax modes and includes AIGC watermark controls. The changes have been localized across 17 languages to ensure accessibility for a global audience.

items.title: Enhance SDK with hcaptcha and captcha support in S D K 🚀
items.summary: This update adds missing hcaptcha and captcha endpoints across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, ensuring API surface parity. New resource paths and client wiring have been implemented, along with task endpoint routing synchronization. Comprehensive tests have also been added to validate the new functionality.

items.title: Enhance Admin Diagnostics for Checker Failures in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the admin interface always displays diagnostic information for failed checker events, even when no specific error details are available. Key changes include the addition of localized fallback messages for all supported languages and improvements to the diagnostic rendering logic. This enhancement will provide operators with clearer insights into failures, improving overall user experience.

items.title: Enhance Error Diagnostics for OpenAI Checker in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the error handling for the OpenAI checker by ensuring that actionable diagnostics are preserved during failure events. Key changes include enforcing default values for `error_type` and `error_excerpt`, as well as cleaning up stale error fields on successful events. The modifications enhance the clarity of failure reasons provided to the admin console, thereby improving operational transparency.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with New Resolution and Watermark Features in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces 768P and 2K resolution options along with watermark parameters for all MiniMax MCP generation tools. It mandates prompts in every mode and requires images for audio guidance, ensuring a more robust user experience. Additionally, the exact resolution pricing has been published in the documentation for better transparency.

items.title: Fix normalized resolution billing values in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns Gateway-normalized `768p` and `2k` values in MiniMax billing rules, ensuring accurate pricing. Regression tests have been added to cover the normalized payloads, and the `/price` endpoint now correctly returns 2.40283288 Credits for 768P × 4s. Additionally, a test overcharge has been refunded and ApiUsage corrected.

items.title: Enhance Pricing and Documentation in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces detailed documentation for the 768P and 2K request fields, including the exact pricing for the largest package. Key changes include the requirement of a prompt in all modes and the addition of audio/image constraints. These enhancements aim to improve user experience and clarity in API usage.

items.title: Enhance Document Resolution Pricing in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update documents the pricing for 768P and 2K resolutions, along with watermark and required prompt rules. All generation examples have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring clarity for users. These enhancements aim to improve user experience and understanding of the minimax video generation process.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax with Resolution Pricing Controls in Dify 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces resolution and AIGC watermark controls for MiniMax Dify generation, enhancing user customization. It enforces prompt requirements and image/audio constraints while updating the payloads to be resolution-aware. Additionally, tests and documentation have been updated to reflect these changes.

items.title: Streamline Responses Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the github-proxy2 by omitting the `temperature` and `top_p` parameters when bridging to a Responses-only upstream model. It aligns the behavior with the established Responses dialect, improving compatibility and reducing HTTP 400 errors. The changes have been validated with successful test results, ensuring a smoother experience for users.

items.title: Confirmed hcaptcha CLI Parity with Latest Docs in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies that the hcaptcha CLI is in full alignment with the latest OpenAPI documentation. A thorough audit was conducted, confirming that all endpoints and command options match the specifications without any need for code changes. The repository remains unchanged, ensuring stability while maintaining documentation accuracy.

items.title: Enhance GitHub Proxy to Handle Disabled Thinking in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the GitHub proxy to treat `enable_thinking: false` as a no-op when processing requests for Responses-only models. It ensures that requests with `enable_thinking: true` are still rejected to maintain correct reasoning semantics. Focused bridge tests have been added to cover both scenarios, improving the reliability of the service.

items.title: Enhance Captcha Protection in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update implements a robust policy to block captcha token-solving requests targeting `acedata.cloud` and its subdomains. Key changes include the normalization of various URL formats to prevent hostname bypasses and the introduction of a new `PROTECTED_CAPTCHA_DOMAINS` setting. The update ensures a consistent rejection of unauthorized requests across multiple captcha services, enhancing security for all users.

items.title: Update Suno Docs API Sync in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the Suno OpenAPI by renaming the audio-generation exclusion field from `style_negative` to `negative_tags`. The MCP already forwards this updated field, ensuring no source changes are necessary. Regression tests confirm that the existing coverage effectively handles the new field.

items.title: Enhance CLI Video Options in Clis 🎥
items.summary: This update aligns the `hailuo` CLI with the latest OpenAPI specifications for the `minimax` service. Key changes include the addition of new request options for video generation, such as resolution and watermark settings, along with input constraints for image and audio URLs. The documentation and tests have also been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring a smoother user experience.

items.title: Align MCP Video Tool Schema with Latest Docs in M C Ps 🎥
items.summary: This update synchronizes the `minimax` MCP server schema with the latest OpenAPI documentation, introducing new video-generation request fields while maintaining existing endpoint behavior. Key changes include the addition of `MinimaxResolution` and updates to the video tools to handle new parameters like `resolution` and `aigc_watermark`. The documentation and tests have also been aligned to reflect these enhancements.

items.title: Enhance Codex Model Exposure in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update preserves the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/models` data array while exposing normalized entries as top-level models for Codex model-manager compatibility. It also includes tests to ensure both response fields are covered, improving the integration with VS Code Codex. This change addresses issues with model refresh errors in the Codex extension log.

items.title: Enhance hcaptcha CLI with rqdata support in Clis 🚀
items.summary: The hcaptcha CLI has been updated to support the optional `rqdata` field in token-generation requests. Users can now include `--rqdata TEXT` when using the `hcaptcha token` command, enhancing the flexibility of token requests. Additionally, documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring users have clear guidance on the new functionality.

items.title: Enhanced MiniMax H3 Pricing for 768P and 2K Outputs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces resolution-aware pricing for the MiniMax H3 model, specifically for 768P and 2K video outputs. The pricing aligns with the largest-package USD rates, enhancing the billing structure. Additionally, documentation has been updated to reflect these changes, including the model catalog, OpenAPI specifications, and bilingual guides.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha Token with rqdata Support in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for the optional `rqdata` parameter in the hCaptcha token API. The `hcaptcha_get_token` method has been modified to accept this new parameter, which is now included in the API payload. Additionally, the documentation has been updated to reflect this change, and a new test has been added to ensure proper token payload construction.

items.title: Fix custom domain tab rendering issue in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a rendering issue in the custom domain tab by escaping the `@` character in DNS hints using Vue I18n interpolation. The fix ensures that the interpolated host-record marker displays correctly without causing syntax errors. All locales have been updated accordingly, enhancing the user experience across the platform.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha API with rqdata support in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update exposes the optional `rqdata` field in the `POST /captcha/token/hcaptcha` API for Enterprise challenges, allowing for improved handling of specific captcha scenarios. The change maintains existing functionality for standard hCaptcha requests and includes documentation updates to reflect this new field. Additionally, regression tests have been added to ensure the integrity of the API contract.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax H3 Video Processing in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces MiniMax H3 handling to the ephone worker, enabling support for various video task modes including text, first-frame image, multi-image, and audio-guided formats at 768P and 2K resolutions. A dedicated Kubernetes secret has been implemented, and outputs are now directed to the AceDataCloud CDN. Additionally, isolated contract coverage and production manifests have been added to ensure robust deployment and testing.

items.title: Enhance Wallet Usage Attribution in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing signed x402 retries to carry an existing AceDataCloud Credential as an identity-only sidecar. It maintains USDC/x402 as the payment rail while attributing API usage and worker tasks to specific user/application/credential IDs. The actual payer wallet is now stored separately, ensuring a seamless experience for both authenticated and guest users.

items.title: Enhance API Attribution for Auth Errors in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the logging of authentication errors by accurately attributing them to the respective APIs. It resolves the original request path and HTTP method during asynchronous logging, ensuring that registered endpoints are correctly populated while maintaining the raw requested path for unknown routes. The changes are non-blocking, preserving existing authentication responses and billing behavior.

items.title: Enhance hCaptcha Integration in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update connects the hCaptcha feature flag from the server to the AuthFrontend, ensuring that the hCaptcha is rendered correctly across various user flows, including registration and password resets. Key changes include routing API requests to PlatformBackend and implementing a fallback to Turnstile when hCaptcha is disabled. The integration has been validated with successful tests in production environments.

items.title: Stop Unused Probes for Enhanced Coverage in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update halts the Gemini native, Claude chat, and Claude Messages synthetic probes, as customer traffic now ensures adequate production coverage. Other probes remain unchanged, preserving their functionality and performance. The shared production credential for various workloads has also been maintained.

items.title: Enhance Email Signup Limits for Shared Providers in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces separate rate-limit buckets for shared email providers, allowing up to 30 events per hour and 250 events per day while maintaining strict limits for custom domains. The changes also include normalization for shared domains across various registration paths, enhancing the system's ability to manage signups effectively. A production audit revealed significant signup activity from shared domains, prompting these necessary adjustments.

items.title: Enhance Checker Outcome Preservation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the preservation of grouped checker outcomes by ensuring that representative probe success and TTFT are retained during history event rebuilding. The changes also maintain existing failure behaviors and add regressions for better diagnostics. Validation tests have confirmed that all relevant checks passed successfully.

items.title: Enhance OpenAI Checker Probes for Better Performance in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an opt-in grouping for shared checker probes, allowing multiple aliases to share a single network probe while maintaining individual performance metrics. Key changes include improved error logging and the transition from WebSocket to HTTP for child Responses transport, enhancing stability and diagnostics. The rollout plan ensures minimal disruption while monitoring for correlated failures.

items.title: Update SMS Signature for Compliance in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update changes the default Tencent SMS signature from '静觅科技' to '北京静觅网络科技' to align with approved standards. The SMS application ID and template handling remain unchanged, ensuring continuity in functionality. Validation tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Update SMS Templates for Compliance in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces outdated SMS templates with approved versions for domestic registration, password reset, and identity verification. The international template remains unchanged, ensuring consistency across user communications. Validation checks confirm no linting errors and proper type checking.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax API Integration in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: This update maps the `minimax/` directory to the new public `AceDataCloud/MiniMaxAPI` repository, ensuring a seamless transition. Additionally, the API README now includes a link to the hosted MiniMax MCP, enhancing accessibility for users. A targeted sub-repo sync has also been triggered to reflect these changes.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax README with API Reference in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update links the MiniMax MCP README to its public API reference, improving accessibility for users. Additionally, it triggers the mapping of the `minimax/` directory into the `AceDataCloud/MinimaxMCP` repository. These changes aim to streamline the integration process for developers.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax MCP Sync Configuration in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update registers the `minimax/` repository in the MCP monorepo mirror map and publishes it to `AceDataCloud/MinimaxMCP`. This change enables standalone CI and deployment processes to run smoothly for MiniMax. The sync configuration has been verified by parsing the `sync.yaml` file and confirming the mapping.

items.title: Align CLI with Latest Minimax API in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the `hailuo` CLI with the latest Minimax OpenAPI specifications, ensuring endpoint and model alignment. Key changes include updated paths for video and task endpoints, a refined model contract, and new request schema options for generating videos. Additionally, tests have been updated to reflect these changes, enhancing overall functionality and reliability.

items.title: Enhance Template Wizard Diagnostics in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the scheduled-template wizard by refining error handling and enhancing user guidance. Key changes include better diagnostics for remote MCP connections, clearer navigation prompts across multiple languages, and improved display of connection statuses. These enhancements aim to streamline the user experience and provide more actionable feedback during template setup.

items.title: Enhance MCP Connection Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a bug where the AceDataCloud remote MCP connections were incorrectly treated as skill account bindings. Key changes include exposing `execution_type` and `supports_task_binding` in the connection account metadata, ensuring that only skill-backed accounts can be bound while maintaining authorization for remote MCPs. The fix has been validated with production traces and successful TypeScript builds.

items.title: Enhance SVM Payment Verification in x402 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces upstream SVM instruction assumptions with outcome-based verification, ensuring safer payment processing. Key changes include enforcing a single compute limit and price, requiring two signers, and rejecting invalid instructions that reference the fee payer. The modifications enhance security and compliance with the 402 challenge specifications.

items.title: MiniMax MCP Sync Verification Complete in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update verifies the MiniMax MCP implementation against the latest OpenAPI specification, confirming that the server is already aligned with the required changes. Key elements such as model enums, endpoints, and request body fields were compared and found to be in sync, ensuring no source code changes were necessary. This verification enhances confidence in the current implementation's accuracy.

items.title: Enhance Email Delivery Event Pagination in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the email delivery event timeline by implementing server-side pagination, allowing users to fetch events in manageable chunks rather than a fixed set of 500. Key features include new page-size controls, accurate event metrics from backend aggregates, and compatibility with legacy responses during deployment. Additionally, a build-time pagination contract check has been added to ensure consistency.

items.title: Enhance Email Delivery Event Pagination in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces pagination for the admin delivery event API, allowing for improved management of delivery events. Key changes include the addition of an opt-in page and page size options, while maintaining legacy support for the existing 500-item response. The implementation also covers campaign filtering and ensures compatibility and validation for better performance.

items.title: Introducing H3 Multimodal Video Workspace in Nexior 🎥
items.summary: This update adds a new `/minimax` workspace that supports text, up to 9 images, and 3 audio references for video creation. Key features include task polling, previews, downloads, pricing estimates, and SEO enhancements, all localized across 17 languages. The implementation has been verified with ESLint, MiniMax helper tests, and comprehensive i18n coverage.

items.title: New MiniMax H3 API Guides Published in A P Is 🚀
items.summary: We've published comprehensive documentation for the MiniMax H3 API, including a new README, task retrieval, and video generation guides. Key features include detailed endpoint descriptions, sample requests, and pricing information for users. This update enhances accessibility and usability for developers integrating with our API.

items.title: Exciting New MiniMax H3 Video Generation Feature in Skills 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces the MiniMax H3 Agent Skill, enabling the generation of videos from text, multiple images, and audio. Comprehensive documentation on limits, pricing, and async task workflows has also been added to enhance user experience.

items.title: Exciting New MiniMax H3 Video Tools Added in Dify 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces the MiniMax H3 Dify provider, enabling multimodal video generation and task retrieval. Key features include support for image/audio arrays, validation of credentials without incurring costs, and asynchronous processing capabilities. The addition enhances the functionality of Dify, making it easier to create and manage video content.

items.title: Exciting New MiniMax H3 MCP Server Features in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a fully functional MiniMax H3 stdio/hosted OAuth MCP server, enhancing capabilities with text, multi-image, audio-guided, and task tools. It also includes comprehensive distribution metadata for PyPI, Docker/K8s, VS Code, and JetBrains. The implementation has passed all tests, ensuring a robust addition to the project.

items.title: Exciting New MiniMax H3 Video Service and Billing Features in Backend 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces the MiniMax H3 video service catalog, complete with OpenAPI specifications and per-second billing at $0.25. Key enhancements include bilingual documentation, responsive service introductions, and comprehensive billing tests. All API cost tests have successfully passed, ensuring a robust integration.

items.title: Add MiniMax H3 OAuth Client in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a unique first-party OAuth client for MiniMax H3, enhancing the Connector directory with its details. The implementation includes assertions for callback and client ownership, ensuring robust functionality. All related OAuth and Connector tests have successfully passed, confirming the stability of these changes.

items.title: Enhance MiniMax Task Polling Exemption in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update adds the `/minimax/tasks` endpoint to the free polling authorization and recording exemption. Additionally, a focused test has been implemented to lock the exemption contract, ensuring its reliability. These changes aim to improve the efficiency of task polling without incurring additional costs.

items.title: Enhance SSE Frame Preservation in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update preserves blank lines in the Anthropic Messages SSE, ensuring each event/data pair remains a valid frame. It also extracts crucial token usage data for accurate streaming billing and introduces a focused lifecycle regression test. These changes aim to improve the reliability and efficiency of message handling in the service.
